s.note: the family's world of hotel ballrooms
s.how: Butter 6 slices rye bread and cut into small squares. Top with 200g smoked salmon. Whip 100ml crème fraîche with lemon zest and put a dot on each, then add a dill sprig and cracked pepper. Serve cold.

Warm 16 buckwheat blini on a tray at 180C for 5 minutes. Top each with a teaspoon of crème fraîche, about 150ml in all, half a teaspoon of salmon roe and a few snipped chives. Serve straight away on a silver tray if you have one.

m.how: Roast a 1.5kg topside at 200C until 52C inside, about an hour, and rest 20 minutes. Whisk 3 eggs, 150g flour and 300ml milk, pour into very hot oiled tins and bake at 220C for 20 minutes. Make gravy with 400ml stock and pan juices.

w.how: Warm 600ml cream with a split vanilla bean. Whisk 6 yolks with 80g sugar and pour the cream over. Pour into 4 ramekins and bake in a water bath at 150C for 35 minutes. Chill overnight, then sprinkle with sugar and torch to amber.

d.note: Arthur drinks whatever's open, and champagne is always open
d.how: Chill 4 flutes in the freezer for 10 minutes. Pour 15ml crème de cassis into each glass. Tilt each flute and top slowly with 120ml chilled brut champagne so it doesn't foam over, then let it settle. Drop a fresh raspberry into each glass so it bobs in the bubbles and serve straight away, before the fizz fades.
